### I133 fixed-metric audit and I136 birational-positivity discovery — 2026-10-10

[I133](i133-fixed-metric-harmonic-growth.md) independently passes original I130 H1 finite-prefix construction, H2 normalized exhaustion, dilation escape and quantitative normalization obstruction separately, without repairs. Zero-mode counts, arbitrary larger finite cutoffs, band averaging, fixed-p exact matching and all-radius growth retain their scopes. Ball normalization factors are elaborated without changing the original sphere formula. Inherited I127/I124/I112 scopes and literal failures remain.

Route I pays countable geometric scheduling with integrable square-speed envelopes, a common radial factor and the complete mixed Ricci Schur complement. Positive-order derivative bounds and square-speed costs can be summable without total first variation or angular C0 changes being summable. Fixed-cutoff graph contraction and perturbed-transform telescoping are paid, but give no changing-cutoff inverse or global line-growth theorem. Weighted-norm/Gram persistence is sufficient and explicitly unconstructed; an actual round-warped high mode shows that local closeness alone cannot preserve a growth class.
